                                           ORDER


       This matter comes before the Court on pro se Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine’s Motion

to Vacate the September 30, 2026 Hearing and to Decide the Motion to Dismiss on the Papers.

Dkt. 42. Upon consideration of the Motion, and for good cause shown, it is hereby

       ORDERED that the Motion (Dkt. 42) is GRANTED; and it is

       FURTHER ORDERED that the hearing noticed for September 30,2026 (Dkt. 38) on the

Defendant National Center for Missing & Exploited Children's Motion to Dismiss (Dkt. 10) is

VACATED; and it is

       FURTHER ORDERED that the Motion to Dismiss (Dkt. 10) will be decided on the

papers pursuant to Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 78 and Local Civil Rule 7(J).

       It is SO ORDERED.


       The Clerk's Office is directed to provide a copy to pro se Plaintiff at his last known

address.
